description: Says what this account has used and has left of its monthly project allowance, the date it starts again, and, when the limit is reached, how to carry on sooner. A project is identified by the plan's work id and title: the same id and title is one project, and changing either starts a new one. It counts when a tool that makes a finished document (shot list, generation briefs, call sheet, shoot-day pack, edit guide, edit file) first makes one for it that month. Drafting, checking and fixing never count, and a project that already had a finished document made this month stays open all month, up to the fair-use limit. A fair-use limit also applies: up to 20 finished-document calls for any one project and 60 for the account each month. Call this before starting a project if you want to know whether a finished document will be available. Input: none. Output: shoot-plan.allowance/1 with projects_used, projects_allowed, projects_left, resets_on and a message. The allowance belongs to the account, not the key, so a new key does not reset it. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. No AI model runs. This tool never counts toward the allowance. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).
name: shoot_plan_allowance
title: How many projects this account has left this month
